create_glm47_parser: create a Glm47MoeModelToolParser instance with a tokenizer and optional tools list to parse GLM-4.7 tool calls
parse_streaming_text: parse streaming text with Glm47MoeModelToolParser.extract_tool_calls_streaming to incrementally extract tool calls from partial model output
extract_tool_calls: extract complete tool calls from model output using Glm47MoeModelToolParser.extract_tool_calls method
adjust_chat_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest with Glm47MoeModelToolParser.adjust_request to configure structured output for tool calling
register_parser: register Glm47MoeModelToolParser as a named tool parser using the @ToolParser.register_tool_parser decorator
